info.title: FusionRAG
info.summary: FusionRAG (Enterprise Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation) API backend combining dense vectors and BM25 sparse search with cross-encoder reranking.
info.description:
# FusionRAG API

Production-ready, highly observable, verifiable AI Document QA and retrieval platform.

## Features
* **Hybrid Retrieval**: Dense embeddings (Qdrant) + BM25 Sparse Search fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
* **Neural Reranking**: Cross-Encoder model scoring for high-precision context relevance.
* **Evaluation Framework**: Automated Faithfulness, Context Relevancy, and Hallucination metric pipelines.
* **Streaming QA**: Low-latency token streaming with inline grounded citations.

Set or change password for the authenticated user.
If the account has an existing password, current_password must be provided and verified.
If the account has no password (OAuth-only), current_password is not required.

delete.description:
Permanently delete the authenticated user's account.

Requires the account password to be re-entered so a stolen access token
alone cannot destroy the account (account-takeover protection), and
rate-limits attempts per user so the re-entry field cannot be
brute-forced. The database ON DELETE CASCADE constraints remove the
user's sessions, conversations, and documents. The client's refresh
cookie is cleared so the browser no longer holds a stale session.
